title: Core System Series
description: A reference-driven core series establishing the main system and three coherent variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the canonical system; images 02-04 preserve the same visual logic while varying surface and function.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-variant-one, 03-variant-two, 04-variant-three. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
